stem: Pipeline A must catalog new S3 partitions once every hour regardless of activity. Pipeline B must start within seconds whenever a new object lands. Which two trigger choices match these needs?

options.label: A
options.body: Use a time-based schedule (cron) for pipeline A’s crawler/job

options.label: B
options.body: Use S3 Event Notifications or EventBridge object-created rules for pipeline B

options.label: C
options.body: Use only object-created events for pipeline A so it never runs on quiet hours

options.label: D
options.body: Use a fixed hourly schedule for pipeline B to poll for new files

options.label: E
options.body: Require manual console starts for both pipelines

explanation: Fixed schedules guarantee hourly runs. Event-driven object notifications meet near-real-time needs. The reverse choices break each requirement.
